# Codec2 golden fixture

`modem_2400b_short.wav` is the one-second, 48 kHz, signed 16-bit PCM waveform
generated by Codec2 revision `96e8a19c2487fd83bd981ce570f257aef42618f9` and copied from
`freedv2400b-java`. Codec2/FMFSK is copyright David Rowe; FMFSK and VHF framing
identify Brady O'Brien as an author. Distributed under GPL-3.0-only.
